summary: ICZOOM Group Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting the resignation of director Wei Xia for personal reasons and the appointment of Yi Wang as a director and committee chair, effective May 22, 2026. The resignation was not due to any disagreement with the company. This is a routine board change with no special situation event such as a takeover, activist campaign, or strategic review. The filing is a standard corporate governance disclosure for a foreign private issuer.
